query: NIFC National Interagency Fire Center year-to-date acres burned wildfires as of mid-July 2026, latest daily figures July 11 12 13 2026, and daily burn rate increments
answer:
I've completed the research and submitted the structured findings. Here's a summary of what I found:

## Key Findings: NIFC YTD Acres Burned — Mid-July 2026

**Mid-July target (July 11–13, 2026):** The best available data point is the **Week of July 13, 2026** figure: **~3.45 million acres burned year-to-date** across **38,747 fires** (~133% of the 10-year average, National Preparedness Level 4). This is NIFC-sourced (via the Property Guardian weekly outlook, citing NIFC's Incident Management Situation Report). No separate standalone daily snapshot for July 11 or July 12 was published in accessible sources.

**Weekly time series (NIFC-sourced):**
| Date | YTD acres | YTD fires | % 10-yr avg |
|---|---|---|---|
| July 6 | ~3.14M | 35,884 | 157% |
| **July 13** | **~3.45M** | **38,747** | **133%** |
| July 20 | ~3.85M | 40,357 | 135% |
| July 24 (NIFC live) | 4,010,417 | 41,779 | — |

**Daily burn rate increments (derived from weekly totals):**
- July 6→13: ~44,000 acres/day
- July 13→20: ~57,000 acres/day (fastest)
- July 20→24: ~40,000 acres/day
- Average over July 6–24: **~48,000 acres/day**

**Important caveats:** NIFC's public statistics page only retains the current live figure (not historical dailies), so the daily series is reconstructed from weekly snapshots rounded to ~0.01M acres, limiting day-to-day precision. IMSR figures are also periodically revised. 2026 has tracked well above the 10-year average all season.
